title: nageia ferruginea
intro: Nageia ferruginea, commonly known as the Rusty-cheek or Yellow Birch, is a species of coniferous tree in the family Podocarpaceae. It is native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The plant is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Nageia ferruginea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
